_help: Read by tools/ops/backup_learner.py and install_ops_tasks.ps1 (its clone key); the S1-4 watchdog will read it too, once built. The scheduled tasks run the DEPLOYMENT CLONE's copy of this file, so a change here reaches them by commit + push to main and the clone's next fast-forward. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_backup_dir: Z: (WD HDD 4 TB, 181 GB free on 2026-10-19), a different physical disk from C:, chosen by the user on 2026-10-21 (USER RULING 42, 06). A nightly backup is about 1.2 MB. The tool refuses any folder on the learner's own volume, and any folder under ops_dir.
_ops_dir: The ops folder every backup ALSO captures (the backup status; the S1-4 watchdog's samples and state once it exists); %LOCALAPPDATA% is expanded. An explicit key since 2026-10-21 (it used to be the status file's folder, implicitly): a destination inside it made each zip contain every earlier one, so the tool refuses a backup_dir or a clone under it, and an ops tree over 200 MB.
_status_file: Outside the clone, so the backup never writes a path there; %LOCALAPPDATA% is expanded. It will be read by the S1-4 watchdog and tools/status.py.
